name: Protopasta Stainless Steel PLA @base
filament_notes:
Steel-filled PLA. Material Data Table: 200C up to 24 mm3/s, 55C plate; avoid printing below 3 mm3/s; hard steel nozzle and gears recommended. FAQ: 195-220C (215C with a 0.5 mm nozzle). TDS: 198C, 60C bed.
Dense (about 2.3 g/cm3; about 90 m per 500 g) and more brittle than PLA as filament. Finish by wire brushing, tumbling, or wheel polishing with compound.
